C08-M05-L02-F2.title: From scored alerts to the next case an analyst works
C08-M05-L02-F2.caption: Per-alert scores are grouped by entity, aggregated into entity risk, adjusted for time and context, and finally chosen by an analyst, whose dispositions feed back into rule confidence.
C08-M05-L02-F2.alt: Top-to-bottom flow of six steps. Score each alert: severity x confidence x criticality. Deduplicate and group by entity: host, account, source address. Entity risk: WS-104 6 alerts, gopal 1. Adjust for time: waiting time, SLA deadline. Adjust for context: campaign intel, account privilege, live access. Analyst takes the next case: override allowed, with a recorded reason. Note under the flow: analysts' dispositions update rule confidence, which changes next week's scores.
